notes.title: PATCH 1.1.1
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that this minor patch is fixing a lot of bugs that were present in Wild Glory!

Most of them being bugs reported from the community at Steam and feedback received during events.

Linux version also received all the new stuff that was added in Patch 1.1

Thank you all, I hope you have a better experience now :)

notes.title: Last Patch's bugs will be fixed soon!
notes.notes:
We definitely hear you guys, and the bugs that started appearing in the last patch will be fixed soon!
We are a very small team and haven't had much time to work on that in the past few days, but you can expect all these fixed to be reaching in a few.

notes.title: PATCH 1.1!
notes.notes:
The new patch is finally out! We are happy to announce that and we hope to see you enjoying it!

> ALL GAME MODES

	> GUI
		 Main menu JUKEBOX option created!
		 Battle Lobby TUTORIAL page created!
		
		Main menu structure changed.
		Battle Lobby and Main Menu can now be navigated using the mouse.
		Battle Lobby cursor speed increased.
		Logos Intro can now be skipped.
		
		Gladius Bots should be automatically spawned when you start a match alone.
	
	> GAME FLOW

		Respawn time lowered.
		Hazard's drop diversity increased.

	> COMBAT

		All hits had their collision box increased.
		Consecutive stuns are now much weaker.
		HIDDEN: All hits now apply a quick slow effect on another gladius.
		
	> DASH
	
		Dash now does refill even when you are blinking.
		Dash cooldown increased.
		Dash cooldown now decreases much faster if you are walking towards another gladius.

	> WEAPONS

		Katana buffed, damage and hitbox increased.
		Katana stun adjusted, time increased, but now you can break the stun.
		Axe buffed, spin damage increased.
		Basic Hammer buffed, damage and attack speed increased.

	> HAZARDS

		Bombs are now detonated when another explosion blats them.
		Lions' base health points decreased (Non-Lion Attack mode only).

> CLASSIC ARENA

	>GAMEFLOW

		Classic Arena match time decreased.
		Another gladius' crowd are now much easier to steal.

> LION ATTACK MODE
	
	> SHOP SYSTEM

		Score renamed to Gold.
		Gold is now global and no longer belongs to a specific gladius.
		Gold is no longer obtained by defeating lions.
		Defeating a lion now makes the crowd throw lots of coins.
		Gold can now be obtained by collecting coins.
		Boxes' text price updated.
	
	> GAME FLOW

		Respawn timer now triggers instantaneous after death.
		Some attacks can no longer be canceled by lion's attack.
		All weapons in Lion Attack are now faster.
	
	> LIONS

		All lions had they attack system updated, should look much more clear.
		White Lions now have a unique new pattern.
		White Lions' shield gap increased.
		Boss Lion's base health increased.

	> PERKS

		Yellow perk now can permanently destroy shields.
	
> EXPLOSIVE SOCCER

	> GAME FLOW

		Bombs now slow down when close to other players.
		Bomb's claim color should be more clear to identify.
		Dash distance increased.
		
> HAMMER FLAG

	> GAME FLOW

		Coins drop rate increased.
		Flag's coin rate increased.
		Flag coin rate speed increased in the first few seconds after you get it.
